architecture.based_on: TS-Cast (Chae et al., Ocean Science, 2026), adapted to OceanEmbed GLORYS Native36 gridded labels
architecture.spatial_patch: 9x9; shared fully-convolutional sliding-window implementation, 4 x 3x3 spatial Conv3D layers, replicate halo 4
architecture.temporal_reduction: 31 -> 16 -> 8 -> 4 -> 2 via replicate-padded pairwise pooling, then average final two bins; newest day is retained
architecture.input_boundary: trailing past 31 days including target date; no future predictors
architecture.coordinate_encoding: Earth-centred XYZ derived from latitude/longitude sine-cosine features
architecture.temporal_encoding: target-day sine/cosine annual phase supplied to the location-wise conditioning branch
architecture.auxiliary_context: 31-day normalized DUACS ADT relative to train-only 12-month ADT climatology; proxy for paper's dynamic-height seasonal context, not identical
architecture.profile_decoder: depth-only 1D U-Net represented as Conv3D with spatial kernel 1x1; FiLM conditioned on local satellite latent vector
architecture.uncertainty_head: depth-wise log variance, trained by masked Gaussian NLL
architecture.omitted_paper_component: density-constraint loss omitted because current supervised targets contain temperature only, not paired GLORYS salinity profiles

run.full_validation_epochs: epoch 1, every 5 epochs, and final epoch
run.numerical_stability: FP16 scaler starts at 4096, non-finite gradient batches are skipped with scaler backoff; 6 consecutive skips stop after checkpoint

splits.boundary_policy: input window must remain inside the date split

target.training_target: all 36 native levels; train-only monthly climatology anomaly / train-only per-depth anomaly std
target.test_policy: held out; not evaluated during this run
